name: Avatar Battlegrounds [BETA]
desc:
🌊 Water. 🌎Earth. 🔥Fire. 🍃Air.  Master the elements, choose your nation, and battle in epic fights in the official Avatar: The Last Airbender game on Roblox!

📱💻🎮 All devices supported!
⭐ Please like & favorite the game for more updates.

🎮 Controls
G - Ultimate
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Cancel/Evade
Left Click - Punch
B - Emote

Join the official Roblox group and sign up for notifications to get the latest game updates!: https://www.roblox.com/groups/34003303/Official-Avatar-The-Last-Airbender#!/about
